subject: Renewal: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, and procurement evidence
messages:
From: Allison Cheng <allison.cheng@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge for upcoming renewal

Hi Rachel,

We're kicking off Greenline Health's annual renewal run for Redwood and procurement has asked for the most recent SOC 2 Type II and a bridge letter covering the period until the next Type II is available. Can you confirm: 

- Do you have a Type II covering a mid/late-2026 audit window? If so, what's the official covered period?
- Will you provide a signed bridge letter that confirms coverage from the report end date to a specified date (we'll need at least a 90-day bridge if possible)?
- Are redacted copies acceptable for procurement, or do we need the full report under NDA?

Our renewal/expansion timeline: procurement needs evidence by 2027-02-28 to complete their review and send an approval package to finance. If you can get something over early next week that would be ideal.

Also attaching our procurement checklist so you can see the other items they'll pack with the SOC deliverables.

Thanks,
Allison Cheng
Senior Sourcing Manager
Greenline Health
allison.cheng@greenlinehealth.com
(415) 555-0127

Date: Fri, 5 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge for upcoming renewal

Hi Allison — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the checklist.

Short answers up front:
- We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2026-04-01 through 2026-09-30 (report issued 2026-11-12). We can provide a redacted PDF for procurement immediately.
- We can issue a signed bridge letter that extends evidence coverage through 2027-05-31 (90 days beyond your Feb 28 deadline) — we typically do a 90-day bridge for renewals, but we can tailor the final date if you need longer.
- Procurement generally accepts a redacted report for initial review; full report can be shared under an NDA or via a secure link.

Action items for us: 
- I'll upload a redacted copy of the Type II to a secure drive and circulate a bridge letter draft by EOD Tue (2027-02-09).
- Marissa, can you confirm the bridge wording and sign-off workflow?
- Dev, if legal needs to add any clauses for limited distribution, please advise and we can route the redacted copy.

Allison — can you confirm whether procurement requires the SIG/CAIQ responses as part of the initial package or if those can come in a follow-up? If they need them now, we'll prioritize a completed CAIQ export.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim

Hi Rachel — great, thanks. Procurement confirmed:

- They need the redacted Type II + signed bridge letter delivered by 2027-02-18 to get the internal packet ready.
- SIG/CAIQ is preferred but can follow if you can provide an estimated completion date; if you can give a CSV or a link to the CAIQ export within the same timeframe that would be ideal.
- Full report under NDA only if needed later in the review.

I've looped Legal (Ben Kramer) because they sometimes require a corporate signature block on bridge letters for our contract team. Ben — can you confirm whether a PDF with an electronic signature is sufficient, or do you require an original wet signature?

Thanks — we're planning to include this in a renewal package tied to the expansion PO, so timing is a bit tight.

Allison
